key_terms: The timestamp a record carries from its source contract, as opposed to processing time, the worker's clock.
A declaration that event time has progressed past a position. It is an estimate, not proof that no older record will arrive.
A watermark strategy that sets the watermark to the maximum observed timestamp minus a fixed delay, trading latency for completeness.
A fixed-size, non-overlapping event-time window, such as the half-open intervals [0, 2000) and [2000, 4000) in milliseconds.
A separate output stream that receives records arriving after their window's watermark has passed, instead of silently dropping them.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
